chunks: Чтобы сделать её напоминанием для вас, и чтобы ухо, способное запоминать, сохранило её.
ai.seo_question: Каково значение 'внимательного уха' в учении Корана?
ai.summary: В Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Haqqah underscores that divine revelation serves not merely as information but as a transformative 'remembrance' (dhikr) requiring active cognitive engagement. The concept of the 'attentive ear' (udhun wa'iyyah) is interpreted as the faculty of the heart and intellect that internalizes the message, a theme resonating with the Quranic call to 'listen and understand' in Surah Al-A'raf.
